dedupe_keys.name: industryforge plant level energy demand production and co2 emissions for european industry 2023 mines paris psl

description: A plant-level dataset of energy use, output and emissions for about 4,600 industrial installations in Europe in 2023. The Zenodo record says it covers the EU-27, the United Kingdom, Norway and Switzerland across 31 sectors, with nine energy carriers at facility and NUTS-2 level, production tonnages, a per-installation breakdown of verified CO2 emissions, typed provenance and two quality scores on every record, and national energy balance totals conserved exactly by construction. It was built by the open-source IndustryForge pipeline (build 2023_20260907-1114, 69 automated checks passed, 9 warnings); the ZIP holds Parquet files, a manifest and a QA report, with a sources inventory and a data dictionary, about 2.9 MB in all, published on 17 August 2026 as a free download under CC BY 4.0. A Data Descriptor has been submitted to Scientific Data and a 2019-2024 extension is planned. Coverage is Europe. Caveats: energy per plant is partly modelled from national balances, as the quality axes flag. For simulation it gives the electricity, gas and heat demand of each industrial site, to model how energy supply cuts or prices hit industry. A related catalogue record is the Hotmaps industrial sites excess heat data.
